key.name: enabled-metrics
key.description: Ordered list of metric identifiers. Order here is the order they appear in the panel. This list also decides what gets sampled: a metric that is not listed is never polled, so removing one costs nothing at runtime.

key.name: cpu-style
key.description: Preset used to render the CPU metric, or custom to use cpu-custom.

key.name: memory-style
key.description: Preset used to render the memory metric, or custom to use memory-custom.

key.name: temperature-style
key.description: Preset used to render the temperature metric, or custom to use temperature-custom.

key.name: network-style
key.description: Preset used to render the network metric, or custom to use network-custom.

key.name: disk-style
key.description: Preset used to render the disk metric, or custom to use disk-custom.

key.name: cpu-custom
key.description: Per-axis overrides used when cpu-style is custom.

key.name: memory-custom
key.description: Per-axis overrides used when memory-style is custom.

key.name: temperature-custom
key.description: Per-axis overrides used when temperature-style is custom.

key.name: network-custom
key.description: Per-axis overrides used when network-style is custom.

key.name: disk-custom
key.description: Per-axis overrides used when disk-style is custom.

key.name: separator
key.description: Character or spacing used between adjacent metrics in the panel.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: Interval for the single shared timer. Lower values cost more wakeups, which is the dominant power cost, not the arithmetic.

key.name: net-unit
key.description: Whether network throughput is shown in bytes or bits per second.

key.name: disk-unit
key.description: Whether disk throughput is shown in bytes or bits per second.

key.name: temp-unit
key.description: Whether temperatures are shown in Celsius or Fahrenheit.

key.name: show-percent-sign
key.description: Append a percent sign to percentage values. Turning this off saves a little panel width.

key.name: graph-width
key.description: Width of a sparkline before HiDPI scaling is applied.

key.name: history-length
key.description: Length of the ring buffer backing each sparkline. Bounded deliberately: this buffer is allocated on enable and released on disable, and must not grow over time.
